central_thesis: Prospective US easing supports duration, but weaker labor and demanding earnings hurdles require selective equity exposure. China remains defensive with operational platform exceptions; Poland pairs domestic resilience with inflation, fiscal and exporter-currency tension.

author_claim_review.scope: Read AUTHORING.md and BRIEF.md fully, the two designated August voice excerpts, own frozen feed/card and own selected exclusion advisory. Reviewed all 136 nonretail paragraphs against exact cited titles and relevant own-card instrument fields. This is an author self-review, not an independent acceptance receipt.
author_claim_review.headline_discipline: Concrete assertions remain within titles. Commentary, forecasts, analyst changes and questions are attributed. No article-body statistics, contracts, sales estimates, target prices, holdings, flows, social posts or historical episodes were supplied from memory.
author_claim_review.market_discipline: Every quoted level and return was compared with its own instrument/horizon. All quoted exchange and crypto observations are September 5. Treasury uses its September 5 close, 2Y 3.75%, 10Y 3.73%, spread -2 bps, changes -25/-23 bps and exact inverted/bull-steepening wording. Crypto uses prior completed daily-close tags. No spot-FX numbers, WDC/CMCSA levels, rescaled share units or calculated ratios.
author_claim_review.source_windows: Applied meaning-based seven-day company-news/preview, fourteen-day result and thirty-five-day macro/current-policy windows. Older Salesforce/Nvidia/Lululemon/Dollar General/Elastic references are completed late-August results, not pending previews. Current policy comments are dated background.

release_status.disposition: Broadcom is treated as completed September 5 after-close reporting before the September 6 UTC cutoff. The September 5 card price is explicitly identified as preceding the after-hours reaction; no post-report price is invented.
HPE is a completed result and annual-profit-forecast increase, not an upcoming earnings event.

Accepted under early-local Japanese release discipline: household spending morning release falls before the following UTC midnight. Used only the exact barely-grew description; no numerical print or unsupported period detail. This is author release-status judgment, not independent certification of original article vintage.
August China activity descriptions are completed by this cutoff; differing survey descriptions are retained without inventing a combined reading.
Jobs, the prospective Fed cut, the robotaxi reveal and the tariff determination remain conditional/pending. October 10 is supported by the Electrek title; no release outcome is imported.
Volkswagen closures are considered, not implemented. ASML service restrictions are a might-be policy risk, not a completed cutoff.

author_claim_review.company_role_review: AirTrunk role is explicitly limited to data-center operator, supported by n2783 alongside the n1259 financing report. TSMC is discussed through manufacturing utilization; ASML through equipment/services access. No Polish company appears in the sector deep dive.
author_claim_review.flows_review: Used actual reported global bond-fund inflows, hedge-fund sector bets and Indian foreign-investor purchases only for the title-supported actions. ETF prices are not fund-flow measures. Nvidia repurchase approval is distinguished from executed purchases.
author_claim_review.cross_section_consistency: Duration protection and conditional cyclical additions are consistent across US, earnings, liquidity and labor/Fed scenarios. China platform exceptions do not reverse the broad domestic-demand stance. The six catalysts agree with sector risks and entry triggers.
author_claim_review.metaphorical_titles: Takata shift-gears and oil plan-A language remain attributed descriptions; no specific action, schedule or mechanism is invented from those metaphors.
author_claim_review.original_vintage_limit: Frozen index timestamps establish source membership but do not independently archive publisher-original vintages. Doubtful German industrial-production and eurozone inflation outcomes were omitted. Independent editorial review remains required.

additional_not_used.reason: German industrial production outcome may belong to report-day European release; omitted.
Nominal August 20 timestamp conflicts with August inflation outcome timing; no need to use this item.
Advised article-vintage ambiguity; alternative energy and monetary-policy sources used.
Advised original-vintage ambiguity; alternative eligible manufacturing descriptions used.
Conflicting Nvidia subpoena claims avoided rather than choosing one.

validation.nonretail_render: All 136 parts rendered through tools/render.py Doc.parts with own-date evidence into scratch preview; 126 citation IDs resolved. Full nine-section renderer intentionally left for root after retail merge because it requires retail keys and reads a global exception file outside author scope.

retail_handling: Retail draft and retail notes were neither read nor edited. No retail keys existed in this spec; later merge belongs to root.
